extracted.intended_audience: Agency ADP customer/user offices and ADP service organizations (e.g., office directors and information processing coordinators preparing the OMB A-79 semiannual ADP report)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing the semiannual report of accomplishments in the use and management of ADP (per OMB Circular A-79): describe new/revised computer applications, ADP operations management accomplishments, and plans for the next fiscal year, including estimates of benefits and savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting organization and period covered
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting Organization / Period Covered 2nd half FY 71
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the reporting organization and state the period covered (e.g., second half FY71).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of inputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs should describe new and revised ADP applications (Section I) and computer operations management accomplishments (Section II) during the second half of fiscal year 1971 (i.e., January - June 1971).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section I normally furnished by ADP customer/user offices; Section II normally furnished by ADP service organizations. Restrict inputs to items implemented or accomplished during the report period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Describe benefits of new or revised computer-based systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain the benefits of each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during this report period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each system, provide concrete explanations of benefits realized during the reporting period (not general plans).

rubrics_metrics.name: System Description
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports. Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the system's functions, program linkage (category/subcategory/element), any contractor role, and whether the system has community or external users or interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel savings — man‑years estimate
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if we were to perform the necessary functions manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a numeric estimate (people or man‑years) and brief justification comparing automated vs manual staffing needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative means and cost comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: If you consider an alternative means (e.g., contractor) feasible to accomplish the objectives of this system briefly explain this alternative and furnish your estimate of relative cost advantages or disadvantages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe feasible alternatives (such as contractor provision), and supply comparative cost estimates or qualitative cost advantages/disadvantages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other benefits (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List and briefly quantify or describe operational benefits beyond personnel savings (e.g., faster processing times, error reduction, improved service).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section II — ADP management accomplishments (overall requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain the benefits of significant ADP operations management accomplishments such as those indicated below. Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar savings which should result.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each management accomplishment, explain benefits and estimate equipment, personnel, or dollar savings expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardization or integration of computer systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Standardization or integration of computer systems
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe standardization/integration actions taken, explain resulting benefits, and estimate equipment/manpower/dollar savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvements in ADP methods or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Improvements in ADP methods or technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document methodological or technological improvements, explain operational impact, and estimate resulting savings or performance gains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe contract negotiations that produced better terms, quantify cost savings or improved service terms relative to Federal Supply Schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress in handling ADP security problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report security problem remediation, policies, or safeguards implemented and their impact on risk reduction and operational continuity; estimate any resource savings if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize R&D activities, expected capabilities/benefits, and projected savings or performance improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section III — Plans for next fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize actions planned or underway which are expected to result in ADP accomplishments of the sort indicated in SECTIONS I and II, above. Include a statement of anticipated benefits for each such action planned or underway.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each planned action, state the action, timeline/status (planned/underway), and anticipated benefits (staffing, cost, efficiency, capability).

rubrics_metrics.name: User/Customer plans (application of computers)
rubrics_metrics.description: User /Customer Plans which deal with the application of computers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe user/customer-led planned efforts to apply computing solutions, linking each plan to anticipated benefits and to Sections I/II outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer center management plans (improving operations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computer Center Management Plans for improving computer system operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe data center or operations management plans intended to improve system operations and list expected benefits and savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification marking and submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's report to the International Programs Division, OMB, will be classified at the security level indicated by your submissions. Please furnish your response to DDS/IPC by 23 July.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure each submission carries the appropriate security/classification marking and meets the stated submission deadline (provide to DDS/IPC by the date specified).

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility allocation for inputs
rubrics_metrics.description: The information in SECTION I normally should be furnished by ADP customer /user offices ... The information in SECTION II normally should be furnished by ADP service organizations such as OCS, RID, CRS, and NPIC (PSG/AID).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the stated allocation of responsibilities: customer/user offices supply Section I content; service organizations supply Section II content; coordinate where functions overlap.
